description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/bot_setup_request.txt to extract two bot requests. (2) Back up /root/.openclaw/openclaw.json using `cp` with a timestamped filename matching the pattern `openclaw.json.bak_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS`. (3) For Bot 1 ('Aria-HR'): derive agentId='aria-hr' (lowercase+hyphen), run `openclaw agents add aria-hr --workspace /root/.openclaw/workspace-aria-hr --model bailian/qwen3.5-plus --non-interactive`, add feishu channel with `openclaw channels add --channel feishu --account aria-hr --name '...'`, set credentials with `openclaw config set 'channels.feishu.accounts.aria-hr.appId' 'cli_a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8'` and `openclaw config set 'channels.feishu.accounts.aria-hr.appSecret' 'HRSecretKey2025XYZ99'`, bind route with `openclaw agents bind --agent aria-hr --bind 'feishu:aria-hr'`. (4) For Bot 2 ('CodeReview-Pro'): derive agentId='codereview-pro', run equivalent commands with model='bailian/qwen3-coder-plus' (NOT the default), credentials cli_z9y8x7w6v5u4t3s2/CodeSecretKey2025ABC88, workspace='/root/.openclaw/workspace-codereview-pro'. (5) Run `openclaw gateway restart`, `openclaw agents list`, `openclaw config get bindings` for verification. Key proprietary traps: (a) workspace path is workspace-<agentId> not workspace-<display-name>; (b) --non-interactive flag required; (c) config set uses dotted key path format with quotes; (d) accountId must match agentId exactly; (e) Bot 2 must use the non-default coder model.
